s.note: Anna's very excited about the chocolate
s.how: Make two ganaches: 150g dark chocolate with 75ml hot cream, and 200g white chocolate with 60ml hot cream. Chill 3 hours. Roll the dark ones in cocoa and the white ones in icing sugar like snow. Pile on a silver plate.

s.note: the carrot he shares with Sven, and Olaf's nose
s.how: Toss 2 bunches baby carrots with 2 tbsp honey, thyme and 30g melted butter. Roast at 200C for 25 minutes until caramelised. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt for the dip. Share one with the reindeer.

m.note: a Nordic dinner in the castle
m.how: Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 50g soaked breadcrumbs, a grated onion and half a tsp allspice. Roll and brown in butter, then simmer in 200ml stock and 150ml cream. Serve with 1kg potatoes mashed and lingonberry jam.

w.note: something warm while Arendelle freezes over
w.how: Mix 450g flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp cardamom, 60g sugar, 250ml warm milk, 1 egg and 60g butter and prove an hour. Shape 12 buns, press a hollow and fill with thick custard. Bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Spread icing on top and dip in coconut.

d.note: the trading post and sauna on the mountain
d.how: Warm 1 litre full cream milk with 4 lightly crushed cardamom pods and 1 cinnamon stick until steaming, then turn off and steep 10 minutes. Strain, return to the heat and whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate, 2 tbsp brown sugar and a pinch of salt until smooth and frothy. Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream, a few marshmallows and grated chocolate.
